load_pretrained_weights: load pretrained DINO weights into a PyTorch model from a local checkpoint file or remote URL
load_pretrained_linear_weights: load pretrained linear classifier weights for a ViT model from the DINO reference checkpoint
init_distributed_mode: initialize PyTorch distributed training mode using torchrun, SLURM, or single GPU environment variables
cosine_scheduler: build a cosine annealing learning rate schedule with optional linear warmup for training epochs
multi_scale: compute multi-scale feature embeddings by averaging model outputs at three different image scales
